questions_and_answers.question: What is the function of the auxiliary verb 'lassen' in German?

answers.answer: It allows one to have something done

questions_and_answers.question: Which English verbs create a similar construction to German 'lassen'?
Which sentence translates to 'Get your hair cut, too' using lassen?

answers.answer: Lass dir auch die Haare schneiden
Hol mich dort um eins ab
Sei bitte um vier Uhr bei uns

questions_and_answers.question: Which sentence shows the use of lassen in the formal Sie-form?

answers.answer: Lassen Sie diesen Artikel doch bitte übersetzen
Ich lasse heute nachmittag meine Schuhe besohlen

questions_and_answers.question: How would you express 'I'm getting my shoes soled this afternoon' in German using lassen?

answers.answer: Ich lasse heute nachmittag meine Schuhe besohlen
Ich lasse heute nachmittag meine Schuhe besohlen lassen
Ich lasse meine Schuhe heute Nachmittag besohlen
Ich lasse Schuhe besohlen heute Nachmittag

questions_and_answers.question: In the example 'Weißt du, wo Klaus seine Anzüge reinigen lässt?', what is being asked?

answers.answer: Do you know where Klaus has his suits cleaned?
Do you know if Klaus cleans his suits himself?
Do you know whether Klaus will clean his suits?
Do you know when Klaus cleans his suits?

questions_and_answers.question: Which German auxiliary verbs are mentioned as analogous to lassen in verb phrases?
What English grammatical construction is comparable to German 'lassen'?
Which of these sentences does not use lassen?

answers.answer: Ich lasse heute nachmittag meine Schuhe besohlen
Lass dir auch die Haare schneiden
Lassen Sie diesen Artikel doch bitte übersetzen

questions_and_answers.question: What is the translation of 'Lass dir die Haare schneiden'?

articles.text:
C. THE AUXILIARY VERB LASSEN
The auxiliary verb lassen occurs in verb phrases with an infinitive, just as können, müssen, werden, etc. (see Units 2, 3 & 9). English has a similar verb phrase with a form of the verbs have or get and a participle.
Lass dir auch die Haare schneiden. (Get your hair cut, too.)
Lassen Sie diesen Artikel doch bitte übersetzen. (Have this article translated, please.)
Ich lasse heute nachmittag meine Schuhe besohlen. (I'm getting my shoes soled this afternoon.)
Weißt du, wo Klaus seine Anzüge reinigen lässt? (Do you know where Klaus has his suits cleaned?)
